why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature, confirm the domain against the project's own profile before touching it (forensics flags it)
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Open montramarkets.xyz only from the link on Montra's X account, @MontraXYZ. Copycat sites and fake bridges around Elysium are common.
Check any wallet on the airdrop page. "Paste any address. No connection, no signature." This shows your retroactive and points standing.
Buy, hold or trade tokens from the weekly Top 10 list shown on the airdrop page. Only the amounts inside the caps count.
For the free route, post about Montra or bring a project, then submit it on the airdrop page and follow the Discord ticket process to get it verified.
Check your address again after each weekly review, and watch @MontraXYZ for the claim date.
